script:
#!/bin/bash
set -u
echo "=== OS & KERNEL ==="
cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^(PRETTY_NAME|VERSION_ID)=' || uname -a
uname -m
echo "=== CPU ==="
nproc
lscpu 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Model name|CPU\(s\):' | head -3 || true
echo "=== MEMORY ==="
free -h
echo "=== DISK ==="
df -h / /var/www 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 || !seen[$1]++'
echo "=== RUNTIME & TOOLS ==="
for cmd in python3 pip3 git docker caddy tailscale gdb nmap sqlmap node; do
  if command -v "$cmd" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ver=$("$cmd" --version 2>&1 | head -1)
    echo "  [OK] $cmd -> $ver"
  else
    echo "  [--] $cmd (not installed)"
  fi
done
echo "=== LISTENING PORTS ==="
ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -20 || netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true
